en: A single fixed pulley provides a mechanical advantage of exactly 1, unlike a movable pulley which provides an advantage of exactly 2.
A third-class lever always has a mechanical advantage of less than 1, meaning it multiplies distance rather than force like a first-class lever.
Ice has a friction coefficient of about 0.03, making it roughly 25 times slipperier than rubber on dry asphalt, which has a coefficient of 0.8.
Earth's gravity accelerates falling objects at 9.8 meters per second squared, which is about 6 times faster than the Moon's gravity accelerates them.
The Moon's gravity is one-sixth of Earth's, so an object weighing 600 Newtons on Earth weighs only 100 Newtons on the Moon.
A neodymium magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight, making it the strongest type of permanent magnet available.
A standard alkaline AA battery provides exactly 1.5 volts of electrical potential energy, whereas a typical car battery provides 12 volts.
Light travels at 299,792 kilometers per second, which is about 880,000 times faster than the speed of sound in air.
Red light has the longest visible wavelength at about 700 nanometers, while violet light has the shortest at approximately 400 nanometers.
Sound travels at 1,480 meters per second in water, which is over four times faster than its 343 meters per second speed in air.
Water remains liquid for exactly 100 degrees Celsius, from 0 to 100, whereas ethanol remains liquid for a much wider 192-degree range.
A 10-watt LED bulb produces the same light output as a 60-watt incandescent bulb, using six times less electrical energy.
